name: gs
description: Portable engineering skills for product intent, public interfaces, and internal implementation.

interface.longDescription: Three composable engineering skills for coding agents. Product shapes intent and acceptance. Frontend designs and verifies graphical and programmatic interfaces. Backend implements and verifies internal logic, data, and execution.
defaultPrompt: Shape this feature into the smallest complete behavior and acceptance criteria.
Design and verify the public interface for this feature.
Fix this internal behavior and verify it through its normal entry point.
